name: electron-stack-spike
description: Concurrent Electron development with independently bundled backend runtimes
author: AIUI experiments

scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.package:prepare: npm run build && npm run runtimes && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs
scripts.package:dir: npm run package:prepare && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.package:dmg: npm run package:prepare && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.package:signed: npm run package:prepare && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.config.cjs
